thread.title: Trump Administration Cuts $1 Billion in School Mental Health Grants
thread.title_full: Trump Administration Cuts $1 Billion in School Mental Health Grants

author: Jim Thomas
title: Trump Administration Cuts $1 Billion in School Mental Health Grants
text:
• The Trump administration announced a cut of $1 billion in school mental health grants.
• The funding was originally established under a bipartisan gun violence prevention law signed by former President Joe Biden.
• The administration cited misuse of funds for diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives instead of direct student support.
• Department of Education officials claim grant recipients used the money for race-based staffing initiatives.
• Madi Biedermann, deputy assistant secretary for communications at the Education Department, stated the grants should focus on improving students' mental health.
• Conservative activist Christopher Rufo reported the funding cuts, alleging the grants were used to advance left-wing racialism.
• The Education Department plans to re-envision and re-compete its mental health program funds.
• The decision aligns with broader efforts to scale back federal education funding influenced by DEI priorities.
• The U.S. Supreme Court recently upheld the Education Department's decision to block grants for teacher preparation programs with inappropriate DEI elements.
• Youth mental health remains a pressing concern, with one in six U.S. youth aged 6 to 17 experiencing a mental health disorder annually.
• Half of all mental health conditions begin by age 14, yet roughly half of affected youth receive no treatment.
• A 2019 report indicated that 15% of adolescents aged 12 to 17 received mental health services at school.
